parent_objective: implement bounded measured intervention smoke for eligible T5 high-speed rows
blocked_by: measured intervention rows are needed before any T5 candidate materialization audit
supersedes: manual intervention checks without artifact schema

public_gates: M1517 must implement bounded T5 intervention smoke
M1517 must attempt the four eligible t5_high_speed_close_obstacle targets
M1517 must write intervention rows pair summary guardrails and summary
M1517 must keep candidate materialization and corpus export false
M1517 must not train run PPO promote use private holdout or alter actor inputs
forbidden_shortcuts: do not claim self-identification from intervention plumbing

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: implements bounded measured interventions for the M1516 T5 high-speed subset
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: intervention runtime evidence only; no candidate materialization, training, PPO, promotion, private holdout, paper-level or level3 self-identification claim
stop_condition: stop if deterministic replay cannot reach decision for the eligible targets
stop if intervention variants require actor-input contract changes
stop if implementation would mutate hidden simulator state directly
stop if implementation would materialize candidates or export corpus
fallback_plan: if replay-to-decision fails, route to runner state-capture design
if wrong-history donor fails, keep reset/zero/delayed evidence and log wrong-history repair
if intervention rows are written, route to measured intervention audit

admission_evidence: M1516 designed bounded intervention variants and artifact schema for the T5 high-speed subset
allowed_updates: status queue scoreboard research log and review
one follow-up intervention audit or blocker manifest
next_stage_criteria: margin gaps and success drops are measurable or failures explicit
next audit or blocker is explicit

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M1517 can measure response/history ablation effects but cannot alone prove level3 self-identification, especially if wrong-history is only donor-hidden diagnostic.
history_necessity_tests: normal vs reset/zero/delayed/wrong-history margin gaps must be measured
null effects must be recorded as evidence about intervention or task strength
self_id_evidence_discipline.temporal_evidence_window: eligible T5 high-speed retarget rows and post-decision continuations only.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If interventions do not change outcome, record the null result and route to audit instead of weakening the claim standard.
allowed_claims: M1517 implements bounded T5 intervention measurement
no promotion, corpus export, training, PPO, private-holdout, paper-level result or level3 self-identification claim

hypothesis: A bounded intervention smoke can produce measured margin gaps or explicit null results for the eligible T5 high-speed retarget rows.
success_criteria: all four eligible T5 high-speed targets are attempted
intervention rows pair summary and guardrail artifacts are written
candidate_materialized training replay PPO promotion private holdout and actor-input changes remain false
failure_criteria: intervention module or tests are missing
intervention variants or artifact schema are incomplete
candidate materialization corpus export training PPO promotion private holdout or actor-input changes occur
decision_rule: M1517 passes if bounded T5 interventions run or fail explicitly with artifacts and all guardrails false.
